result.quote: If you were to give me half your possessions, I still would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water in this place.
result.reason: The key is supported as a paraphrase of “I still would not go with you,” but the question broadly asks what he says. His reply also says that he would not eat bread or drink water there, so materially different answers are defensible. The question should specify which part of his reply is being requested.
